name: Dihexa
description: Small modified peptide made from angiotensin IV (N-hexanoic-Tyr-Ile-(6) aminohexanoic amide)

note.text: FDA has not identified any human exposure data. The main paper on how it acts was retracted in 2025.

bullets: **Reported** to bind HGF and raise c-Met signalling (lab work, paper retracted 2025)
**New nerve-cell connections** seen in the developers' lab tests
**2013 founding paper** has a journal notice of concern (2021)
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Rat, mouse, zebrafish and cell studies only
No human study or registered trial

practical.routes: None studied in people (by mouth in rats)
practical.soldAs: No approved product; not on FDA compounding lists

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy
Not named; S0 status not stated

references: FDA, bulk drug substances that may present significant safety risks (Category 2), Apr 2026
J Pharmacol Exp Ther, first description of dihexa (McCoy et al.), Jan 2013
J Pharmacol Exp Ther, retraction notice for Benoist et al. 2014, Apr 2025
